title: Render text diagnostics from the firmware upgrade socket
problem: Firmware upgrade refusals arrive as WebSocket text frames, but the page converts every payload to Uint8Array and silently renders those strings as empty output.
reproduce: Deliver ERROR: invalid upgrade parameters as a string to the upgrade socket handler; the baseline terminal receives no diagnostic.
acceptance: Text frames reach the terminal unchanged and binary frames continue through the streaming UTF-8 decoder.
repair: Append string payloads directly and retain the existing TextDecoder path for binary payloads, with a focused browser-VM regression.

selection.reason: A same-day camera-team report includes captured frame opcodes, exact lost diagnostics, no competing PR, and a deterministic existing WebSocket harness.

verification.limitations: BCL exercises the real upgrade page in the repository's VM harness and preserves the binary path. The full npm suite has unrelated environment-dependent Telegram/ntfy still-capture failures. No firmware was flashed and no physical camera was used.
verification.ownerCheck: Trigger a refused upgrade on a camera and confirm its ERROR text appears in the firmware progress pane; also run an aborting upgrade and confirm the final unchanged-camera sentence remains visible.

negative.outputIncludes: FAIL a text-frame refusal reaches the transcript unchanged
